claude.semantics: Higher scope wins; multiple roots at one scope remain ambiguous. Managed/session entries require explicit JSON captures.

opencode.semantics: Definitions merge in loading order. Inventory preserves all layers and reports merge-required rather than reconstructing runtime permissions.

policy_audit.plugin_scope: Native plugins accepts ordered strings or package/options objects; legacy plugin retains string declarations. Inventory reports exact package specs as configured, never loaded. Mixed spellings, unknown shapes and runtime ID removal/wildcard directives are conservatively unsupported; migration and runtime ID/package resolution are not inferred.
policy_audit.guard_scope: Global-vs-agent permission precedence is unverified. With an old global ask/deny, new or changed agent allows refuse unless the ordered policy is identical or only tightens allow effects in place. Narrow allows are subject to this guard too.
policy_audit.scope: Known configured patterns only. Native permissions and agents use plural keys. Last matching rule wins within an ordered ruleset. The loader normalizes legacy permission and typed flat MCP; native-container absence is not a defect. Mixed containers and unfamiliar shapes are refused rather than inferred. Cross-file loading and effective access remain unverified. Muse profiles do not cover the native approval-policy store; coverage_gap and unsupported remain findings and prevent apply.

limits: Exact versions only. Paths are explicit, not discovered from the current machine. Builtin rows describe documented runtime inventory, not observed loading. Other versions and providers remain unsupported.
